newsitem.title: BRAZIL: McDonalds french-fryer blast injures two in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: McDonalds french-fryer blast injures two in Brazil.

text.p: A tub used to make french fried potatoes exploded at a McDonalds Corp. restaurant in Sao Paulo, seriously injuring two workers who were covered with hot cooking oil, authorities said on Friday.
Police said they were investigating the cause of the blast, which spewed a load of hot oil over Ailza Cristina de Moraes Prado, 30, and Ana Alice Bittencourt, 18.
Both women were rushed to a nearby hospital where they were treated for serious burns, a police spokesman said.
McDonalds was not immediately available for comment.
